description: This file defines a trait 'SignatureTrait' used for AWS Signature Version 4 signing process. It provides methods to create signing scope strings and generate signing keys with caching.

classes.name: SignatureTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing methods for AWS SignatureV4 signature calculations, including cache management, scope creation, and signing key generation.

methods.name: createScope
methods.description: Constructs a signing scope string using date, region, and service.

methods.name: getSigningKey
methods.description: Generates and caches the signing key used for AWS Signature V4, utilizing HMAC hashing and cache management to improve performance.
